title: Day 607 — Sheinbaum Delivers Second Government Report 'En Defensa de la Soberanía' at Monumento a la Revolución; Security Gains and Record FDI Lead Agenda
detail: On May 31, 2026 (Day 607), President Claudia Sheinbaum delivered her second major government accountability report — titled 'En Defensa de la Soberanía' (In Defense of Sovereignty) — live from the National Palace at 10:00 AM, with tens of thousands of supporters gathered at the Monumento a la Revolución esplanade in Colonia Tabacalera, Mexico City. The event was simultaneously broadcast on public screens in plazas and government spaces across all 32 state capitals. The Zócalo was unavailable due to FIFA World Cup 2026 Fan Fest construction ahead of the June 11 opener. Mexico City Mayor Clara Brugada had called a mass mobilization at the monument from 9:00 AM, and Morena's territorial structures organized transportation from all states. The report marked approximately two years since Sheinbaum's June 2, 2024 electoral victory (59.76%). KEY FIGURES AND ANNOUNCEMENTS: (1) SECURITY: Daily intentional homicide average fell 49% from inauguration (86.9/day in Sep 2024 → 44.3/day in May 2026); 54,297 priority targets detained; 402.8 tons of drugs seized; 2,400 clandestine labs destroyed; 92 suspects extradited to the U.S.; 85 public officials arrested over two years. (2) ECONOMY: Labor poverty fell 3.2 percentage points (33.9% Q1 2025 → 30.7% Q1 2026); record Q1 2026 FDI of $23.591 billion; 12 consecutive months of minimum wage increases above inflation; 2.5% unemployment rate. (3) SOVEREIGNTY NARRATIVE: The report's central theme was explicitly framed around Mexico's resistance to foreign pressure — 'Mexico is nobody's colony, nobody's protectorate' — in direct response to the CIA expulsion (May 28) and the U.S. DOJ indictment of Sinaloa Governor Rocha Moya (April 29). Sheinbaum referenced the EU-Mexico Global Agreement (May 22) as evidence of Mexico's successful diplomatic diversification strategy. (4) INFRASTRUCTURE: Key milestones cited included the Tren Felipe Ángeles AIFA link inauguration (April 26), the first Podecobi economic hub (Tlaxcala, April 16), the IMSS Bienestar expansion to 24 states, and Pemex debt reduction of ~$23B USD. (5) MOTTO: 'La Honestidad Da Resultados' — 'Esta transformación no la detiene nadie' ('This transformation, nobody stops it'). The report was the broadest public accounting of the first 607 days of the Sheinbaum presidency and set the political narrative heading into the FIFA World Cup 2026 opening week and the approaching USMCA Round 2 (June 16–17, Washington).

media.caption: Sheinbaum's May 31 second government report: 49% homicide decline, $23.6B Q1 FDI record, labor poverty -3.2pp — delivered under the banner 'En Defensa de la Soberanía' at Monumento a la Revolución with broadcast to all 32 states
